sum: AH REALTY TRUST INC is a real estate investment trust (REIT) with over four decades of experience. The Company owns and operates high-quality retail and mixed-use office assets located primarily in the Mid-Atlantic and Southeastern United States. AH Realty Trust focuses on disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for shareholders. AH REALTY TRUST INC was incorporated in 1979 in Maryland and is based in Virginia Beach, Virginia.
ceo: Mr. Shawn J. Tibbetts (CEO, President & Chairman of the Board)
